content: Tauri v2 bundles are ~3-10MB vs Electron 120-200MB; ~75% less RAM. Tauri uses Rust backend + OS-native WebView (WKWebView/WebView2); Electron bundles Chromium+Node. 2026 guidance: default to Tauri v2 for new apps unless you need identical Chromium rendering across all OSes or heavy Node-only ecosystem deps.
